analytics.name: Top N by Revenue
analytics.natural_language: Show top {n} customers by revenue in the last {days} days
analytics.sql_template: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, SUM(amount) as total_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '{days} days' GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT {n}

analytics.name: Revenue Trend
analytics.natural_language: Show revenue trend over the last {months} months
analytics.sql_template: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month, SUM(amount) as revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '{months} months' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

analytics.name: Category Performance
analytics.sql_template: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as orders, SUM(oi.quantity) as units_sold, SUM(oi.amount) as revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

analytics.name: Customer Cohort Analysis
analytics.natural_language: Analyze customer cohorts by signup month
analytics.sql_template: WITH cohorts AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as cohort_month, customer_id FROM customers) SELECT c.cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) as cohort_size, AVG(o.total_orders) as avg_orders, AVG(o.total_spent) as avg_revenue FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as total_orders, SUM(amount) as total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.cohort_month ORDER BY c.cohort_month DESC LIMIT 12

analytics.name: Geographic Distribution
analytics.sql_template: SELECT c.region, c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as orders, SUM(o.amount) as revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY c.region, c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

reporting.name: Daily Summary
reporting.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as unique_customers, SUM(amount) as revenue, AVG(amount) as avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE DATE(order_date) = '{date}'

reporting.name: Weekly Report
reporting.sql_template: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', order_date) as week, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(amount) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customers FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '4 weeks' GROUP BY week ORDER BY week DESC

reporting.name: Monthly KPIs
reporting.natural_language: Key performance indicators for the month
reporting.sql_template: WITH current_month AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)), prev_month AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')) SELECT 'Revenue' as metric, SUM(amount) as current_value, (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM prev_month) as previous_value, ROUND(((SUM(amount) - (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM prev_month)) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM prev_month), 0) * 100), 2) as change_pct FROM current_month UNION ALL SELECT 'Orders', COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prev_month), ROUND(((COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prev_month))::NUMERIC / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prev_month), 0) * 100), 2) FROM current_month

reporting.name: Year-over-Year Comparison
reporting.natural_language: Compare this year vs last year performance
reporting.sql_template: WITH current_year AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) as month, SUM(amount) as revenue FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY month), last_year AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date + INTERVAL '1 year') as month, SUM(amount) as revenue FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 GROUP BY month) SELECT TO_CHAR(COALESCE(c.month, l.month), 'Month') as month_name, c.revenue as current_year_revenue, l.revenue as last_year_revenue, ROUND(((c.revenue - l.revenue) / NULLIF(l.revenue, 0) * 100), 2) as yoy_growth FROM current_year c FULL OUTER JOIN last_year l ON c.month = l.month ORDER BY COALESCE(c.month, l.month)

monitoring.name: Active Users
monitoring.natural_language: Show active users in the last {hours} hours
monitoring.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as active_users, COUNT(*) as total_actions FROM user_activity WHERE activity_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '{hours} hours'

monitoring.name: System Performance
monitoring.sql_template: SELECT datname as database, numbackends as active_connections, xact_commit as transactions_committed, xact_rollback as transactions_rolled_back, blks_read as blocks_read, blks_hit as blocks_hit, ROUND(blks_hit::NUMERIC / NULLIF(blks_hit + blks_read, 0) * 100, 2) as cache_hit_ratio FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname NOT IN ('template0', 'template1', 'postgres') ORDER BY numbackends DESC

monitoring.name: Slow Queries
monitoring.sql_template: SELECT query, calls, total_time, mean_time, max_time FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE mean_time > {threshold_ms} ORDER BY mean_time DESC LIMIT 20

monitoring.name: Table Sizes
monitoring.sql_template: SELECT schemaname, tablename, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename)) as size, pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) as size_bytes FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') ORDER BY size_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

troubleshooting.name: Failed Transactions
troubleshooting.natural_language: Show failed transactions in the last {hours} hours
troubleshooting.sql_template: SELECT transaction_id, error_message, created_at, customer_id, amount FROM transactions WHERE status = 'failed' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '{hours} hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC

troubleshooting.name: Duplicate Records
troubleshooting.sql_template: SELECT {column}, COUNT(*) as occurrences FROM {table} GROUP BY {column} HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY occurrences DESC

troubleshooting.name: Missing Data
troubleshooting.sql_template: SELECT 'customers_without_email' as check, COUNT(*) as count FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL OR email = '' UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_without_customer', COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'products_without_price', COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price IS NULL OR price <= 0

troubleshooting.name: Orphaned Records
troubleshooting.sql_template: SELECT 'orders_without_valid_customer' as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'order_items_without_valid_order', COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

data_exploration.name: Column Statistics
data_exploration.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT {column}) as unique_values, COUNT({column}) as non_null_values, MIN({column}::TEXT) as min_value, MAX({column}::TEXT) as max_value FROM {table}

data_exploration.name: Value Distribution
data_exploration.sql_template: SELECT {column}, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 2) as percentage FROM {table} GROUP BY {column} ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

analytics.name: Top Customers
analytics.natural_language: Show top {n} customers by total purchases
analytics.sql_template: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, SUM(amount) as total_spent, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT {n}

analytics.name: Product Performance
analytics.sql_template: SELECT p.product_name, p.category, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as times_ordered, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(oi.amount) as total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20

analytics.name: Sales by Hour
analytics.natural_language: Show sales pattern by hour of day
analytics.sql_template: SELECT HOUR(order_date) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(amount) as revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(order_date) ORDER BY hour_of_day

reporting.name: Daily Revenue
reporting.natural_language: Daily revenue for the last {days} days
reporting.sql_template: SELECT DATE(order_date) as date, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(amount) as revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(order_date) ORDER BY date DESC

reporting.name: Customer Lifetime Value
reporting.sql_template: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, MIN(order_date) as first_order, MAX(order_date) as last_order, COUNT(*) as total_orders, SUM(amount) as lifetime_value, AVG(amount) as avg_order_value FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 100

monitoring.name: Database Status
monitoring.natural_language: Show current database status and metrics

monitoring.name: Active Connections
monitoring.sql_template: SELECT ID, USER, HOST, DB, COMMAND, TIME, STATE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND != 'Sleep' ORDER BY TIME DESC

analytics.name: Warehouse Credit Usage
analytics.natural_language: Show credit usage by warehouse over last {days} days
analytics.sql_template: SELECT WAREHOUSE_NAME, DATE(START_TIME) as DATE, SUM(CREDITS_USED) as CREDITS FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.WAREHOUSE_METERING_HISTORY WHERE START_TIME >= DATEADD(DAY, -{days}, CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY WAREHOUSE_NAME, DATE ORDER BY DATE DESC, CREDITS DESC

analytics.name: Query Performance
analytics.sql_template: SELECT QUERY_TYPE, COUNT(*) as QUERY_COUNT, AVG(EXECUTION_TIME)/1000 as AVG_EXEC_TIME_SEC, MAX(EXECUTION_TIME)/1000 as MAX_EXEC_TIME_SEC, SUM(CREDITS_USED_CLOUD_SERVICES) as TOTAL_CREDITS FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY WHERE START_TIME >= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) GROUP BY QUERY_TYPE ORDER BY QUERY_COUNT DESC
